description:
Start here to install ConsentEase on a website. One idempotent call: creates the site (banner configuration, default cookie categories, first cookie scan) or, when you already have a site for the same normalized domain, returns that existing site. Calling it again never creates a duplicate.

Getting started:
  1. consentease_setup_site with the domain → returns the real install snippet for this site.
  2. Place "snippet" in the <head> of every page, as high as possible and above Google Tag Manager / gtag, then publish the website.
  3. consentease_check_installation with the returned siteId → verifies the live installation (setupScore + open items).

Args:
  - domain (string): Bare domain such as "example.com" (protocol, "www" and path are removed server-side).

Returns JSON: { status: "created"|"existing", created, siteId, domain, publicId, scriptUrl, snippet, scanStatus: "scanning"|"complete"|"needs_attention"|"not_started", scanStartedNow, nextSteps: string[], installationCheck, site }. Use "snippet" exactly as returned; do not edit or shorten it.

A first scan starts for new sites, and for existing sites only when they were never scanned (20 scans per day per user). There is no website limit per plan; billing is per website. Requires scope: sites:write.

domain.description: Bare domain, no protocol or "www" — e.g. "example.com".

name: consentease_setup_site
title: Set up ConsentEase on a website
